subject: Demo recap + proposed POC scope & success criteria — VelaHealth
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@velahealth.ai>, Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@velahealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for VelaHealth

Hi Samir / Lena —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and clear alignment on the business problem (real-time clinical note summarization and unified patient search). Per our demo, I’m sending a concise POC proposal so we can lock scope and next steps. I attached a one-page POC_Scope and the Data_Specs we discussed.

High-level POC objective:
- Validate that Redwood can deliver accurate, privacy-safe clinical note summarization at production-like latency/cost for a 30k note sample and a small live test.

Proposed success criteria (please confirm):
1) Summary quality: average ROUGE-L improvement from baseline >= 12% on the provided 500-note eval set AND product team sign-off on 20 hand-checked cases.
2) Latency: P95 end-to-end generation per note <= 350ms for batched requests (batch size 8) during the validation window.
3) Cost target: tokenized inference cost below $0.015 per note for the validation workload.
4) Security/compliance: Redwood provides SOC2 summary + ephemeral keys for the test dataset, and required audit logs for access.
5) Integration: secure S3 ingest + small webhook for live validation within two weeks of data access.

Timeline (target):
- Week 1 (Jan 25): Kickoff, access to sample dataset, confirmation of test cases and eval scripts.
- Week 2 (Feb 1): Model onboarding + infra configuration; baseline runs.
- Week 3 (Feb 8): Validation runs, quality sampling, initial results.
- Week 4 (Feb 15): Final tuning, sign-off meeting and handoff notes.

Owners:
- VelaHealth: Samir (project lead), Lena (product validation)
- Redwood: Alex (sales/coord), Marissa (technical lead), Evelyn (CS & delivery)

Immediate asks for you:
- Confirm the success criteria above (especially latency & cost targets) or propose adjustments.
- Share access details for a 30k-note sample (S3 link or dataset export) and one user for webhook testing.

If this looks good I’ll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for the week of Jan 25 and loop in engineering.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: POC_Scope_VelaHealth_v1.pdf, Data_Specs_VelaHealth.xlsx

From: Samir Shah <samir@velahealth.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@velahealth.ai>, Product Team <product@velahealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan for VelaHealth

Thanks Alex — this is helpful and clear. Quick confirmations and a couple questions below.

We agree to the success criteria in principle. Two small asks:
- Latency: can we make the P95 target 300ms instead of 350ms? That’s what our UX team wants for interactive editing. If you think that’s unrealistic for batch size 8, tell us the tradeoffs.
- Security: SOC2 summary is necessary; we’ll also need a redaction plan for PHI in test data and a temporary pseudonymization script. Can your team help with a small pre-processing step?

Data/access: we will share an S3 export (read-only) by EOD Jan 18 and create a cross-account role. I’ll assign a technical contact for the webhook tests — cc’d: Product Team.

We’re happy to run the 20 hand-check cases with our clinicians; Lena will coordinate sign-off.

Let’s schedule the kickoff for Jan 25 at 10am PT — I can make that work.

—Samir
Samir Shah
Head of Product, VelaHealth

Alex — thanks for laying this out. A few internal notes I want to capture in the thread so Samir has visibility: 

- Delivery: Redwood will provision a small dedicated pool on our Dedicated tier for the validation window to guarantee capacity and latency isolation. Marissa will own the tuning and runbook.
- Security: I attached a short SOC2_Summary_Redwood.pdf; for PHI we can provide a pseudonymization helper script and run a dry-run on a copy of the dataset. We’ll need a completed DPA before any live PHI work.
- Observability: we’ll enable token-level cost traces and a per-route latency dashboard for your team during the POC.

I’ll add these items to the kickoff agenda. Alex — please add the DocuSign POC agreement link when you schedule.

Thanks — Evelyn
